newsFlag.summary: Juszczyk is managing a finger injury sustained in early August and returned to full practice participation after a veteran rest day on Tuesday.
Undisclosed
Personal

Evans (groin) returned to practice Wednesday but has dealt with various nagging injuries this summer and his availability for the season opener against the Rams remains uncertain pending any setbacks over the next week.
Mariota returned to practice Monday after missing two weeks with a sprained MCL in his right knee suffered on Aug. 14, and is working to increase his workload ahead of the 2026 season.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey has returned to practice with an undisclosed injury and is trending positively, running and catching passes in full uniform at Tuesday's practice.

Kittle is recovering from an Achilles tendon tear and is trending toward playing in Week 1 against the Rams, though a final decision won't be made until the team arrives in Australia and his snaps may be limited if cleared.
Aaron Jones is active and co-starting for the Vikings, but his age (31) and injury history present elevated fantasy risk compared to backup Jordan Mason.

Watson was named the Browns' starting quarterback after winning the job competition, though he has a history of significant injuries including a torn Achilles tendon and re-rupture that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky missed Wednesday's practice due to a biceps injury but is considered day-to-day and not expected to be a significant concern.
Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 against the Broncos despite recovering from a torn left ACL sustained in December, with improving confidence in his availability.

Alvin Kamara remains sidelined with a sprained MCL suffered two weeks ago and is unlikely to be available for the Week 1 season opener against the Lions, with a return timetable of at least one month.
Jeremy McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and won't be eligible to return until at least Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Undisclosed
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury and must miss at least four games to start the regular season.
DJ Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be available for Week 1.
Jakobi Meyers is returning to practice Wednesday after a hand injury sustained nearly two weeks ago and is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Browns.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Singletary is not in uniform for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, though this appears to be a rest decision rather than an injury concern.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers with an undisclosed injury and cannot return before Week 5.
Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with minimal fantasy impact given his limited role on the Bills offense.
Undisclosed
Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
A.J. Brown is not in uniform for Thursday's preseason game but this appears to be a routine preseason rest rather than an injury concern.
Josh Jacobs remains on the Commissioner's Exempt List with a court appearance scheduled for Sept. 10 on misdemeanor charges, creating significant uncertainty about his NFL availability.
J.K. Dobbins is on track to play Week 1 after limited training camp participation due to a soft-tissue injury that is not considered long-term.
Pittman is dealing with a hamstring injury but is expected to be ready for Week 1 after missing training camp and preseason action.
AJ Dillon secured the third RB spot on Carolina's roster and would see increased playing time if either Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) or Jonathon Brooks (soreness) miss games.
D'Andre Swift left Thursday's practice with an abdominal cramp that caused significant discomfort, but early diagnosis suggests it is not a serious injury.
Tee Higgins is dealing with a bruised heel and did not participate in Wednesday's practice, though the injury is not considered a major concern by the coaching staff.
Burrow is active and optimistic about the 2026 season, though he was limited to 8 games in 2025 due to a toe injury, presenting a moderate durability concern going forward.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday while recovering from a hamstring injury sustained in mid-August and is trending positively toward season readiness.
Brevin Jordan was re-signed by the Texans after being cut, but has ongoing knee issues that have limited his availability and he is expected to return to practice next week.
Jaylen Waddle missed some early training camp time with tightness but is expected to play and is being utilized across multiple offensive formations.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Brock Wright is healthy and could start at tight end for the Lions in Week 1 if Sam LaPorta's hip injury keeps him sidelined.
Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring clearance from an independent neurologist before he can play in Week 1.
Ja'Marr Chase hyperextended his left knee at practice last week and did not participate in drills at Wednesday's practice, leaving his Week 1 status uncertain.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons with an undisclosed injury and will be unavailable for the 2026 season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was placed on the Dolphins' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach a settlement to have any chance to play in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and will be sidelined until at least Week 5.
Bo Melton is active and healthy but faces roster uncertainty due to poor preseason performance and competition for his special teams role.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to an undisclosed preseason injury and will miss at least the first four regular season games.
Isiah Pacheco was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and has no clear timetable for return, with his absence potentially extending beyond Week 5.
Cameron Dicker is working through a minor issue but head coach Jim Harbaugh expects him to be ready for Week 1 against the Cardinals.
Olave missed preseason due to a previous blood clot and had some practice exits in August, but appears to be entering the season in good health.
Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is progressing with individual drills.
Khalil Shakir has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury since preseason Week 1, but there is optimism he will be available for Week 1 against the Texans on Sept. 13.
Allgeier is active and poised to split carries with rookie Jeremiah Love in Week 1, though his workload may decrease once Love fully recovers from his ankle injury.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during a preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.
Undisclosed
Skylar Thompson has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Brittain Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Groin
Metchie was active and participated in preseason action, but has a history of injury issues and is competing for a roster spot with several teammates dealing with injuries.
Pierce returned to full practice participation after offseason ankle surgery and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Calvin Austin III was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Robinson took a hard hit during practice and underwent concussion testing, which came back negative, with early indications he is on track for Week 1.
Breece Hall is expected to be ready for Week 1 despite nursing a groin injury, though his workload may be limited with Braelon Allen emerging as a backup option.
Watson is active on the Packers' 53-man roster and expected to lead the wide receiver room, though he has a history of injury issues that bears monitoring.

Kenneth Walker III was a full participant in Wednesday's practice after dealing with minor ankle swelling from cleat issues, and is expected to be the Chiefs' primary running back for the 2025 season.
Will Mallory was placed on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, eligible to return in Week 5.

Keaton Mitchell missed six consecutive practices with an undisclosed injury and his Week 1 status against the Cardinals is uncertain, with backup Kimani Vidal potentially taking over if he cannot play.
Kendre Miller sustained a minor injury at Tuesday's practice but avoided any serious setback and has a chance to be available for Week 1.
Undisclosed
Washington missed preseason time due to an undisclosed injury in August but has since returned to practice and is listed as active heading into the season.
Scott Matlock was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season, with the earliest possible return in Week 5.
Willis is in the NFL's concussion protocol after suffering a concussion in the preseason finale and must be cleared by an independent neurologist before becoming available.
Tyrell Shavers was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a torn ACL suffered in the wild-card round and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Knee
Princeton Fant has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jake Bobo sustained a serious knee injury during a joint practice with the Titans and has been placed on injured reserve, ruling him out for the entire 2026 season.
Nate Adkins suffered an undisclosed injury during Friday's practice but returned to participate in Monday's training camp session, suggesting the injury is minor.
Emanuel Wilson has been designated as questionable and his availability status is uncertain.

Ben Sims was placed on the Dolphins' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least four games, with a possible injury settlement potentially allowing him to join another team once healthy.
Sean Tucker is dealing with a minor undisclosed injury and missed Wednesday practice, but his availability for Week 1 against the Bengals remains unclear.
Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the preseason finale and missed Monday's practice, but has two weeks to recover before the regular season begins.
Tank Dell suffered a catastrophic knee injury, missed the entire 2025 season, and is opening the current season on injured reserve, ineligible to play until Week 5 at the earliest.

Tucker Kraft is progressing well from a torn ACL suffered in November 2025, appeared to run without limitations in Wednesday's practice, and is on track to play in Week 1 against the Vikings pending clearance from the upcoming injury report.

Josh Downs suffered a minor calf injury that kept him out of some practice time last week, but he was spotted participating in Tuesday's practice and is expected to be off the injury report for Week 1.

Roschon Johnson is currently the only healthy running back on the Bears' active roster after D'Andre Swift suffered an abdominal injury, but Johnson's role has diminished significantly over the past season.
Zay Flowers (lower body) returned to practice Thursday and remains on track to play in Week 1 after targeting that date for full recovery.
LaPorta suffered a hip injury in practice that caused him to miss the final two preseason games, though he returned to drills by Aug. 25 with his status for Week 1 still unclear.
Rashee Rice returned to game action after a December concussion and appears healthy heading into Week 1, though his offseason included a knee procedure and legal issues.
Davis Allen is recovering from a quadriceps injury and was limited in practice but is expected to be available for the regular-season opener.

Puka Nacua is dealing with a groin injury and is making good progress in recovery, but his availability for Thursday's season opener against the 49ers remains uncertain pending the official injury report.

Luke Musgrave was placed on the PUP list and is expected to miss at least the first four games of the 2026 season due to a neck injury sustained during June minicamp, with an uncertain return timeline even after Week 5 eligibility.
Zach Charbonnet remains sidelined with an ACL tear to his left knee suffered in January and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
Johnny Wilson was placed on Philadelphia's injured reserve with a knee injury and will miss the upcoming season unless released with an injury settlement.
Chris Collier reverted to injured reserve with the Raiders on Sunday with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless an injury settlement is reached.
Undisclosed

Malik Nabers (knee) participated in individual and team drills at Wednesday's practice after uncertainty about his Week 1 availability, with his official injury report status to be determined next Wednesday ahead of the Cowboys matchup.
Bowers is returning to full health after a lingering knee injury limited him to 12 games last season and is expected to be active for the 2026 season opener.

Xavier Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice with the Jaguars and will remain in a walking boot until Thursday, expected to miss Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
Coach Canales is optimistic Brooks will play Week 1 despite soreness, but his exact injury status is unclear and he's been working off to the side during practice.
Irving is active and set to lead the Buccaneers backfield, though he faces competition for touches from Gainwell and Tucker, and had a injury-plagued 2025 season with limited production.
Guerendo was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a pectoral injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
Groin
Jamari Thrash has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Tracy suffered a neck stinger in the preseason finale and is practicing in a non-contact jersey, with his availability status uncertain.
Hamstring
Carter Bradley suffered a thumb injury during preseason and was placed on injured reserve, likely sidelining him for the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement with Jacksonville.
Brooks returned to practice after three weeks recovering from hand surgery performed in early August and is targeting the preseason finale against Carolina.
Mason Tipton was moved to the reserve/PUP list after offseason tibia surgery and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Undisclosed
Jeshaun Jones received a three-game NFL suspension for violating the substance-abuse policy and will be ineligible for game action until Week 4.
Reiman was moved to the reserve/PUP list due to an ankle injury and must miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.

Braelon Allen started at RB in place of the injured Breece Hall and is the team's top available running back, though Hall is expected back by Week 1 and Isaiah Davis could compete for backup duties once healthy.

Isaiah Davis is recovering from a knee injury sustained in early August training camp, did not participate in Wednesday's practice, and has not yet been cleared for team drills ahead of the Jets' regular-season opener.
MarShawn Lloyd is active and positioned as the top option in the Packers backfield with Josh Jacobs out, though he has limited regular-season experience.
Erick All passed his conditioning test and is cleared to participate in training camp after undergoing multiple knee surgeries for an ACL injury that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
Theo Johnson is participating in limited practice in a non-contact jersey while recovering from a shoulder injury sustained last Monday, but appears on track to play in Week 1 against the Cowboys.
Harrison has been healthy since late July and is listed as an active starter after missing time with heel and foot injuries in 2024, though he will be working with a new QB in Jacoby Brissett.
McMillan remains sidelined with a knee injury at Tuesday's practice but is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Bengals in 12 days.
Keon Coleman is recovering from a sprained right foot/toe sustained in the preseason opener and has progressed to practicing without his walking boot, with nearly two weeks remaining before Week 1.
Undisclosed
Ben Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and will miss the preseason finale, but his availability for the Sept. 13 season opener is not currently in peril.
Knee - PCL
Penix is recovering from November ACL surgery and his Week 1 starting status remains uncertain as the Falcons evaluate him against Tagovailoa, though he has been cleared for practice reps.
Odunze left Thursday's practice with a right leg injury but is expected to be fine and should be ready for Week 1.
Trey Benson reverted to the Cardinals' injured reserve list due to ongoing knee troubles from his meniscus surgery in October, and was placed on waivers with no takers.
Thomas Yassmin was placed on injured reserve by the Green Bay Packers with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Savion Williams is on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain and is expected to return Week 5 (October 11 debut vs Bears).
Tyler Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties for Baltimore despite recent struggles and the addition of Jake Moody to the practice squad, putting his job security at risk.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs due to an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Ashton Jeanty suffered a low-ankle sprain on Aug. 23 and hasn't practiced this week, though the coach expressed optimism he'll be ready for Week 1 against the Dolphins.
Tyler Warren participated in practice Tuesday after straining his adductor on Aug. 19, and is expected to operate with no restrictions for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Egbuka (toe) is working his way back from injury, demonstrated side field work and running without obvious issues, and is expected to be near full health by Week 1.

Ayomanor exited Thursday's practice early with a left shoulder issue but is practicing Friday and avoided a serious injury.
Jordan James returned to action in the preseason after recovering from a rib fracture, recording 8 rushing attempts for 35 yards and 1 reception for 20 yards.
Gordon is practicing in a non-contact jersey due to a rib injury sustained in the preseason but appears to be progressing in his recovery.

Kyle Monangai remains week-to-week with a right knee hyperextension suffered Aug. 16, though he showed positive signs running on the side Wednesday and may have limited availability to start the season.

LeQuint Allen Jr. is a game-time decision for Week 1 against the Browns with an undisclosed injury, and Coach Coen suggested he'd be 'pleasantly surprised' if Allen plays, indicating the running back is unlikely to suit up.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest possible return in Week 5.

Croskey-Merritt missed the final two preseason games due to a lower-body injury and is expected to return to practice next week, with his participation level to be determined ahead of the regular-season opener.
Moliki Matavao was placed on injured reserve Tuesday due to a knee injury sustained in Saturday's preseason game and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Jacoby Jones was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Commanders.

Beaux Collins was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return, requiring him to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to an undisclosed injury.
Carter Runyon was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to return until Week 5.

Trevor Etienne was placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury suffered in Friday's preseason game and will miss at least four contests.
Tory Horton has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury for over a week, but head coach Mike Macdonald indicated it is not a long-term or significant injury.
Robbie Ouzts has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Hampton was limited in preseason action but is listed as active; he dealt with a fractured left ankle last season but appears to be the Chargers' lead back heading into the 2026 season.

Jaxson Dart reports feeling much better under new offensive coordinator Matt Nagy's scheme, though he experienced five concussion checks last season and his top WR Malik Nabers is still recovering from a torn ACL.
Dillon Gabriel was placed on injured reserve to start the 2026 season with a back injury that coach Todd Monken described as not serious, requiring him to miss at least the first four games.
Skattebo has been cleared with no restrictions after undergoing surgery for a dislocated right ankle in October, though his workload may be scaled back initially in the 2026 season.
Travis Hunter is active for the 2026 season after recovering from a Week 7 LCL injury last year, but his offensive role is unclear as he transitions to primarily cornerback in training camp.
Bhayshul Tuten missed Wednesday practice due to illness but is expected to be healthy by Week 1 against the Browns in 11 days.
Tre Harris missed the final two preseason games with an undisclosed injury but is expected to be available for the Chargers' regular-season opener.
TreVeyon Henderson is recovering from an ankle injury and was held out of Saturday's practice in street clothes, but has two more chances to practice before the Patriots' season opener on Wednesday.

Luther Burden III is recovering from a groin injury suffered in early August and is expected to participate in practice Tuesday, with his availability for the Week 1 opener against the Panthers still uncertain.
Terrance Ferguson is dealing with soreness and working off to the side at practice, but remains active and in contention for playing time as a potential third tight end option.
Isaiah Bond is listed as questionable for upcoming games, indicating uncertainty about his availability.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Makai Lemon made his pro debut after recovering from a nagging hamstring injury and is expected to be the No. 3 receiver for Week 1.
Sarratt is healthy but faces significant roster competition and may struggle to make the 53-man roster with limited production in preseason games.

Adam Randall was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens with a designation to return due to an undisclosed injury, ruling him out for at least the first four regular-season games with an earliest return date of October 11.
Jaren Kanak has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.

Kenyon Sadiq is dealing with a hernia but remains on track to play Week 1 after missing training camp and preseason, though he is expected to have a limited role initially while ramping up activity.
De'Zhaun Stribling is ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against Las Vegas due to a shoulder injury but is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Rams.
Oscar Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at Saints training camp but the severity is unclear and he has time to recover before the preseason finale.
Ted Hurst III is active and available but faces reduced playing time if Emeka Egbuka, Jalen McMillan, and Tez Johnson are healthy for Week 1.
Joe Royer, a rookie tight end, was placed on the reserve/non-football illness list and must miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to a personal issue.
Kaytron Allen is expected to begin the regular season as the third-string running back but could see increased workload if injuries to Jacory Croskey-Merritt or Rachaad White linger into Week 1.

Price experienced lower-body soreness during training camp that sidelined him for a week and kept him out of preseason, but he is expected to be active and have a large workload in Week 1.
Kacmarek is dealing with an undisclosed injury and is considered week-to-week, having missed the preseason finale.
Bell was cleared to return to full practice and played in the preseason finale, but is still working on getting into football shape after ACL surgery rehab.
